items.title: OpenAI bug bounties up to $172,000 — and Cathedral joins its security sprint
items.summary: OpenAI pays outside hackers much more for serious bugs and brings in Cathedral to attack its own systems with AI.

items.title: agent-desktop 1.1 — Vercel Labs' computer-use CLI for AI agents
items.summary: A command-line tool that lets any AI agent see and click native desktop apps, without matching pixels.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.317 — gateway cost report and blocking Agent SDK hooks
items.summary: Claude Code 2.1.317 gives gateway admins a spend report and lets Agent SDK hooks fail closed.

items.title: Pando — OpenAI rebuilt its Git backend for Codex-scale pushes
items.summary: OpenAI's monorepo outgrew normal Git hosting once Codex agents multiplied pushes, so it built Pando.

items.title: Weight-Space Programming — GPT-6 Astra reads and edits network weights
items.summary: A frontier LLM looks at a network's weights, works out what they compute, and rewrites them without any training loop.

items.title: LifeVal — OpenAI's test of AI help with everyday life tasks
items.summary: OpenAI now measures how well its models get real errands done, not just how much they know.

items.title: AI Explained — 'We may release models we can't control'
items.summary: AI Explained reviews a week of safety statements from top labs and the arrival of Gemini 4 Carbon.

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'Dory - NVIDIA's Looped Transformer'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen walks through NVIDIA's Dory, a 4B model that spends more compute per token by looping its middle layers.

items.title: vLLM v0.33.0 — faster speculative decoding, and CUDA 13 builds only
items.summary: vLLM v0.33.0 speeds up speculative decoding on NVIDIA and AMD, adds new open models, and drops CUDA 12.9 builds.

items.title: Claude Code stops cloning existing games — Anthropic adds a two-sentence rule
items.summary: Claude Code on Opus 5.5 now declines to recreate someone else's specific game, citing Anthropic's IP rules.

items.title: ChatGPT and Codex share one usage limit — token-based pool from December
items.summary: From December, one token budget covers ChatGPT Work and Codex on Plus, Pro and Business plans.

items.title: Wes Roth — 'the BIGGEST HACK of all time just started...'
items.summary: Wes Roth links a record crypto theft and a string of breaches to the question of AI-run cyber defense.

items.title: OpenMausBot — an open-source Grok Bot alternative with cloud computers
items.summary: Your own team of AI bots in a chat app, each with its own model, apps and computer.

items.title: Memdoor team-solve — five Qwen3.8-27B agents rerun the GVS5H coding test
items.summary: A small-team workflow of five Qwen3.8-27B agents reruns a paper's claim that it can match Fable 5 on hard coding problems.

items.title: DeepSeek Super-agent — an open coding agent that takes work from GitHub chats
items.summary: DeepSeek's open prototype of an agent that watches a repo's conversations, takes approved requests and answers with finished work.

items.title: Project Suncatcher — Google's satellite runs Gemma 4 on a TPU in orbit
items.summary: Google's test satellite ran an open Gemma model on a TPU in space and sent the answer back to Earth.

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol beats Factorio — a rocket launch on peaceful mode
items.summary: An OpenAI model plays Factorio through code and finishes the game with a rocket launch.

items.title: VOLTA infostealer — malware asks an LLM how much each victim is worth
items.summary: A Windows infostealer sends each victim's stolen profile to an LLM, which ranks what the victim is worth.

items.title: ChatGPT Shared-Link Flaw — one click ran attacker code in the victim's session
items.summary: A public ChatGPT share could run attacker JavaScript inside the viewer's signed-in session until OpenAI patched it.

items.title: Northflank breach — stolen customer secrets used to run up AI API bills
items.summary: A cloud hosting platform tells all customers to rotate every secret after stored AI API keys were used by attackers.

items.title: ChatGPT violence safeguards — chats can end, teens lose weapons details
items.summary: OpenAI tightens ChatGPT's violence rules: chats can be ended, mass-attack details are limited, and teens get no practical weapons info.

items.title: AI training opt-out token — one robots.txt rule for OpenAI and Google
items.summary: A single robots.txt group can now tell several AI providers not to train on a site, instead of one rule per crawler.

items.title: Two Minute Papers — 'OpenAI Claims It Just Did The Impossible'
items.summary: Károly Zsolnai-Fehér looks at OpenAI's claim that its model refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.316 — Opus 4.8 fast mode deprecated, pooled gateway budgets
items.summary: Claude Code 2.1.316 retires Opus 4.8 fast mode on November 30 and lets gateway groups share one monthly budget.

items.title: nesformer — a Nintendo CPU compiled into Qwen3.5 weights
items.summary: A stock Qwen3.5 model whose compiled weights run NES games, one predicted token at a time.
